resources.string: Nocturne reads your sleep stages from Health Connect only when you turn on the sleep overlay, to show them beside your BedJet nights. They are read when you open the Sleep page and are never saved, backed up or sent anywhere. Nocturne writes nothing to Health Connect.
Auto-start

Start one chosen profile on the selected BedJet. Skip if a night is already running, the BedJet can\'t be reached, or the plan changes. Selecting another BedJet pauses this setting; switch Auto-start off and on to link it to that BedJet.

Only if the phone is charging
When charging is required, a 60-second notification countdown lets you cancel before the attempt. Charging and the plan are checked again after the countdown.
The alarm uses the exact-alarm permission already held by Nocturne. Android still controls when the background job can run; an attempt more than 15 minutes late is skipped.
Android uses a 15-minute window. Power saving may delay delivery further; an attempt outside that window is skipped.
